metric_label: Sum of monthly maximum PSPS events affecting any one reported customer account
notes: Missing tract records are not assigned zero.
The published layer uses official 2010 Census tract geometry.
Thirty-nine newer SDG&E records and two local Liberty identifiers are normalized spatially to 2010 tracts.
Duplicate and overlapping source records are collapsed with max within each tract-month before monthly values are summed.
SCE's duplicate CES_FINAL reference feature class is excluded.
